purpose: 생물 카드(자동) — 이후 콘티·영상의 형태 기준

items.name: card_side
items.prompt: A single accurately sculpted, hand-painted collectible miniature figurine of Chaunax stigmaeus, photographed as a macro studio shot. Shape, proportions and colour pattern must be anatomically faithful to the attached real reference photos: The body is bulbous, loose, and highly flexible, tapering to a small rear tail fin. The skin has a velvety texture covered in fine spines, colored orange-red with bright greenish-yellow mottling. It features a large mouth with a protruding lower jaw. Two small eyes with deep rosy red irises are positioned high on the head. Between the eyes sits a modified dorsal spine acting as a lure with filament bundles. It has two leg-like pectoral fins extending laterally and smaller pelvic fins underneath used for resting on the seafloor. Satin hand-painted finish with faint brush texture — clearly a crafted figure, not a slick living animal (운영자 승인 2026-10-01). Shallow depth of field (tilt-shift macro), warm desk-lamp light, plain neutral mid-grey seamless backdrop. Exactly one animal, fully inside the frame. No text, no letters, no labels, no watermark, no logo, no scale bar, no collage, no multiple panels, no split screen, no extra animals, no humans. Must not have smooth scales, a streamlined body, large bulging eyes, or standard thin swimming fins. View: three-quarter side view of the whole body.
